country_title: App Store country for icons, screenshots & descriptions
country_hint: 2-letter code (us, vn, jp...). Doesn't affect IPA downloads.
ipatool_hint: The open-source command-line tool majd/ipatool. The app downloads the latest release from GitHub and verifies its SHA-256.
ipatool_autoupdate: Check for and install ipatool updates every time the app opens
session_hint: ipatool stores your Apple ID session (encrypted) in %USERPROFILE%\.ipatool. The encryption key (keychain passphrase) is generated randomly by the app and protected with Windows DPAPI: only this Windows account can read it.
session_copy_tooltip: To run ipatool from the command line with the same session
session_pass_label: The passphrase you used with the ipatool CLI before

about_update_available: IPA Tool GUI v{0} is available (you have v{1}).

login_need_code: The code must be exactly 6 digits.
login_busy: Signing in... The first time, ipatool needs to set up a virtual device, which can take 1–2 minutes.

setup_finding: Looking for the latest version on GitHub...

toast_busy: An ipatool task is running, try again later.

toast_update_later: ipatool {0} is available. It will be installed when no task is running; click refresh to try again.
signout_confirm: Sign Apple ID {0} out of this computer?
toast_session_expired: Your session expired, please sign in again.
toast_clipboard: Couldn't access the clipboard, try again.

toast_queued: Added “{0}” to the download queue. See Downloads.
toast_download_failed: Downloading “{0}” failed. See Downloads for details.

toast_pass_ok: The passphrase is correct: your previous session was unlocked.
toast_pass_bad: Passphrase saved, but the session couldn't be unlocked. Please sign in again.
toast_running_wait: A task is running; wait for it to finish and try again.
reset_confirm:

toast_gui_none: No IPA Tool GUI release has been published on GitHub yet.
toast_gui_new: IPA Tool GUI v{0} is available. Go to Settings → About to download it.
toast_gui_latest: IPA Tool GUI v{0} is the latest version.
close_confirm:

Quit anyway?
err_unknown: Unknown error. See the Log tab for details.
err_not_logged_in: Not signed in, or the session expired. Please sign in with your Apple ID again.
err_license: This Apple ID doesn't own the app. Turn on “Automatically get licenses for free apps” in Settings, or download the app once on an iPhone with this Apple ID.
err_paid: This is a paid app: buy it on an iPhone/Mac with this Apple ID first, then you can download the IPA.
err_subscription: This app requires a subscription (e.g. Apple Arcade) on this Apple ID.
err_not_found: App not found. Check the bundle ID / App ID; the app may not be released in this Apple ID's country.
err_2fa_digits: The verification code must be exactly 6 digits.
err_2fa_fresh: Apple didn't confirm the code. Get a new 2FA code on your device and try again.
err_disabled: This Apple ID is locked or disabled.
err_unavailable: The app is temporarily unavailable on the App Store.
err_429: Too many requests to Apple (429). Wait a few minutes and try again.
err_403: Apple refused the request (403). Wait a few minutes and try again; if it keeps happening, check for an ipatool update in Settings.
err_network: Network error while contacting Apple. Check your internet / VPN / proxy and try again.
err_passphrase: ipatool needs a passphrase to open the session. Check Settings → Session & security.
upd_no_asset: Release {0} has no file for Windows {1}.
upd_no_github: Couldn't reach GitHub to check the ipatool version: {0}
upd_checksum: SHA-256 checksum mismatch: the download is corrupted. Please try again.
upd_no_exe: ipatool.exe was not found in the downloaded package.
upd_invalid_file: This file is not a valid ipatool.
